source: docs/research/research-tools.md, 3d.md, mockups-and-vector.md, ai-video.md, typography.md (primary sources fetched or searched on 2026-10-03)

conventions.auth_env_origin: Each access entry marks auth_env_origin: 'vendor' when the vendor documents the env var name, 'cstack' when cstack proposes the name because the vendor documents none.
conventions.mcp_tool_patterns: Claude Code names MCP tools mcp__<server>__<tool>. <server> is whatever the user named the server (claude.ai connectors use the display name, e.g. mcp__Figma__*). Match the server segment case-insensitively and also match tool-name fingerprints, never one exact server name.
conventions.confidence: high = read on a vendor-owned page today; medium = vendor page partially confirmed or third-party source only; low = inferred; 'unverified' in a value means no source was found.

tools.name: Cosmos

access.endpoint_or_package: an MCP server named Cosmos, connected as a connector in the owner's agent (seen in the cstack field test 2026-10-03); publisher and tool list not verified here
https://www.cosmos.so (human use in a standard browser)
user shares public cluster URLs or downloads/saves images and drops them into the project

mcp.notes: No official Cosmos MCP or public API found. The cosmos.so MCP servers in circulation are unofficial: 'mrmos/cosmos-mcp' calls the private GraphQL endpoint the web app uses with the user's session token and says it is not affiliated with Cosmos. '@polarity-lab/cosmos-mcp' (env COSMOS_TOKEN) is an unrelated personal knowledge-graph server; do not treat it as Cosmos.

returns: images and clusters curated by the user (via export only)
tools.tos_notes: ToS section 8(F) forbids accessing, searching or downloading with any engine, software, tool, agent, robot, crawler or data-mining tool other than Cosmos-provided software or generally available browsers. Agent-driven browsing of Cosmos is therefore not allowed; a human browsing and exporting is.

agent_use.reason: Cosmos ToS 8(F) allows only Cosmos-provided software or a standard browser, and no Cosmos-provided MCP or API exists; a connected Cosmos MCP is detected but not used for agent search
agent_use.until: Cosmos publishes its own MCP or API, or the owner records a legal opinion that allows it

tools.fallback: Ask the user to paste public cluster URLs or export saved images into the project; route open taste search to Are.na (API) or Taste Labs (MCP) and say Cosmos was not queried.

tools.fallback: The user checks availability in their Adobe account and shares family names; type-director keeps Adobe Fonts choices provisional until the licence scope (web project, desktop, app, broadcast, logo) is confirmed.

tools.name: Foundry trial and test fonts
roles: test retail typefaces in specimens and pitches before licensing

access.endpoint_or_package: trial files the user downloads from a foundry (examples: Grilli Type trials, Zetafonts trial licence, Pangram Pangram free personal-use fonts) and places in the brand workspace under assets/fonts/trial

returns: font files for `cstack type font` inspection and specimen rendering, for testing only
tools.tos_notes: Trial licences are for testing. Grilli Type (trial EULA, March 2019) allows testing and paid or unpaid pitches but no final files; Zetafonts allows unpublished pitches and design tests, leaves numerals 0-9 out of trial files and forbids passing files to clients; Pangram Pangram's free fonts are for personal use, and commercial projects need a licence. Read each foundry's EULA; never publish, deploy or hand over trial files; record trial status in the font's provenance.
tools.fallback: Use the foundry's own web type tester by hand, or explore with open-licence fonts; keep every trial-based choice provisional until it is licensed.

tools.name: fontTools

access.endpoint_or_package: Python package fonttools (current docs require Python 3.11+): fonttools, ttx, pyftsubset, pyftmerge; subcommands subset, merge, varLib, varLib.instancer, feaLib, cu2qu (installing needs the owner's approval)

returns: WOFF2 subsets per script or page (pyftsubset)
static or partial instances of variable fonts (varLib.instancer)
tools.tos_notes: The software is MIT; the font's licence still governs what may be done to the font.
